question.text: Kaveri Macro Fund (Cat III, irrevocable determinate trust) realised INR 40 lakh STCG from STT-paid listed equity shares held 9 months. Using Section 111A post-Budget 2024 rate (ignore surcharge/cess), the pure STCG tax at fund level is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 raised Section 111A STCG on STT-paid listed equity from 15% to 20% with effect from 23-07-2024. Tax = 40,00,000 × 20% = INR 8,00,000 (before surcharge and 4% cess). The workbook's effective-rate table shows 23.92% for individuals/AOP/BOI after surcharge and cess. The Trap: INR 6,00,000 = 15% old rate. INR 4,00,000 = 10%. INR 12,00,000 = 30% MMR base. Candidates who miss the Budget 2024 hike to 20% pick the stale 15%. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/XIX-B (Distributor exams) also test the 15%→20% Budget 2024 hike. XXI-B (PMS) cares for pass-through reporting. XIX-E drills the fund-level impact because Cat III pays on PAN of the fund, not at LP level. Manager's Pro-Tip: For Kaveri's global macro equity leg, the STCG rate jump from 15% to 20% shaves ~5% off each quick trade's net alpha. Re-examine holding periods near 12 months — holding one extra day past 12M drops the rate to 12.5% LTCG, a 7.5-point saving on STT-paid listed equity.
